adaptations: Native dialog semantics, title associations and controlled requests replace prototype hotspots without business effects.
Reference heights are minimums; long text and limited viewport height use internal scrolling.
Filter panel is centered using the native modal surface; no unapproved side/placement API or transition is exposed.
ToastRegion is a stable polite status surface. Message removal is caller-controlled, without timers, queue or persistence.
Public M10 keeps its existing CSS, geometry and 240ms transition. Shared Dialog/Drawer/Toast add no motion.
